muxt generate --use-receiver-type=Server
muxt check

exec go test -race -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "GET /stream datastar(sse(Stream(ctx, send)))" -}}
{{- with .Selector "#list" -}}{{- end -}}
{{- with .Mode "append" -}}{{- end -}}
<li>{{ .Result }}</li>
{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- server.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

// Server appends rows to a live list: each rendered event becomes a
// datastar-patch-elements frame whose selector and mode come from the
// template's chainable setters.
type Server struct{}

func (Server) Stream(_ context.Context, send func(string) error) {
	_ = send("one")
	_ = send("two")
}
-- server_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, Server{})

	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/stream", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	if ct := rec.Header().Get("Content-Type"); ct != "text/event-stream" {
		t.Fatalf("content-type = %q, want text/event-stream", ct)
	}
	body := rec.Body.String()
	if got := strings.Count(body, "event: datastar-patch-elements\n"); got != 2 {
		t.Errorf("body = %q has %d datastar-patch-elements events, want 2", body, got)
	}
	for _, want := range []string{
		"data: selector #list\n",
		"data: mode append\n",
		"data: elements <li>one</li>\n",
		"data: elements <li>two</li>\n",
	} {
		if !strings.Contains(body, want) {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want the wire line %q", body, want)
		}
	}
}
